matrix.option: Patch/minor update inside current direct-package major
matrix.evidence: The only semver-compatible update is brace-expansion 5.0.7 -> 5.0.8 beneath minimatch 10.2.5. Six minimatch 3.1.5 branches remain on brace-expansion 1.1.16 and the audit remains at nine highs.
ESLint 9.39.5 is the latest stable 9.x. eslint-config-next 16.2.11 still introduces stable plugins that require minimatch ^3.1.2. The latest @eslint/eslintrc 3.3.6 still requires minimatch ^3.1.5.

A 5.0.8 override is compatible only for the 5.x branch. Overriding the six 1.x branches to brace-expansion 5.0.8 violates minimatch 3.1.5's ^1.1.7 range. Overriding minimatch 3 to 10 violates plugin ranges and changes the CommonJS export from callable function to object.

An isolated exact ESLint 10.8.0 plus eslint-config-next 16.2.11 candidate leaves six high vulnerabilities. eslint-plugin-import 2.32.0, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y 6.10.2, and eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 all reject ESLint 10 in their peer ranges.

The current Next flat configuration depends on three stable plugins with no drop-in release that both preserves rule coverage and removes minimatch 3. Replacing or removing the configuration would weaken checks.
Every available complete change is incompatible, weakens current lint coverage, or still leaves high findings.
